nodes.title: HubSpot and Zoho CRM contact import, read only, through the stored integration credentials: each pull is an intake upload with a receipt, mapped like a file (agent column contract included); sync re-imports idempotently on the CRM id; timed sync off by default
nodes.details: Tools source.crm.lists (read), source.crm.pull, source.sync, source.sync.schedule (draft); job intake.crm_sync. Tests intake-crm 5/5 against local fakes shaped from the documented responses (research/2026-10-24/crm-import/README.md): lists, paging, 100-id batch reads, token refresh, page_token, consent only from a CRM field, DND unknown, no write calls, unchanged skipped, changed number flagged, timed sync and its failure, plain refusals, tenancy. Not verified: a real CRM account.

nodes.title: A CRM record whose phone number changed since the last import is flagged on the receipt and not imported; one CRM record never becomes two contacts by itself
nodes.rationale: Idempotent on the CRM id. Moving the number automatically is an identity change (it would re-point consent and suppression), which needs a person (contact.merge is A2).
nodes.reverse_if: Buyers find the flag noisy for routine number changes, and a reviewed path that moves the number with its consent history is built.

nodes.title: From a CRM, consent comes only from a field that says so (read as consent by the same header rules as a file, and recorded only with a purpose); email opt-outs and data-processing bases are not call consent; DND is never taken from a CRM
nodes.rationale: Brief: 'consent and DND state come across only where the CRM records it, otherwise unknown, never assumed'. HubSpot hs_legal_basis and Zoho Email_Opt_Out are not about phone calls.
nodes.reverse_if: A CRM adds a standard call-consent or DNC field; then it is mapped by default with its own test.

nodes.title: Contacts > Import > From HubSpot / From Zoho CRM: pick a list, check it with the same column matching and receipt as a file, save, then set a sync timer; failed syncs explained in plain words; empty state links to Integrations
